blocks.text: Kapuso actress Shuvee Etrata reached another milestone for her family as she finally bought them their first-ever family vehicle. The actress shared her personal achievement through her Instagram Stories on Saturday, Oct. 10, showing a photo of the vehicle along with two visibly happy family members. “We did it. First car for my family,” she wrote. A separate video shared by the shop where Etrata bought the vehicle documented the emotional moment when Etrata surprised her parents and siblings.
